meta.description: QR code digital menu and table ordering for cafés and restaurants in Tunisia.

hero.eyebrow: New: import your menu from one photo
hero.title: Your QR code menu,
hero.description: Customers scan the QR code on the table and read your menu in French, Arabic or English. They call the waiter or ask for the bill in one tap, and your team knows at once.
hero.scan: Scan to try the demo on your phone

photo.title: Photograph your menu
photo.body: AI reads the dishes and prices. You check and correct in minutes.

brand.title: Add your identity
brand.body: Logo, colour, hours, Wi-Fi: your menu looks like you.

print.title: Put the QR codes on tables
print.body: One tent per table, ready to print. Customers scan, that’s it.

onlyMenu.q: I only want the QR code menu. Is that possible?
onlyMenu.a: Yes. The QR Menu plan includes your menu online and a QR code per table, without waiter calls or bills. You can move to Basic anytime.

app.q: Do my customers need an app?
app.a: No. They scan the QR code with the camera and the menu opens in the browser, without an account.

start.q: How long does it take to start?
start.a: Under 30 minutes: a photo of the menu, your colours, then printing the QR codes.

print.a: You print them from your space, on paper or at a print shop. We can also point you to acrylic or wooden tents.

internet.q: What if the Wi-Fi is slow?
internet.a: The menu is light and loads fast even on 3G. Customers can also use their mobile data.

change.a: Yes, anytime from your phone: one dish, a category or a percentage increase for many.

staff.q: How do my waiters get the calls?
staff.a: On the counter tablet or their phone, with a sound, a vibration and a notification.

data.a: With European hosts (European Union), backed up every day. Your menu stays yours.

footer.tagline: The digital menu for Tunisian cafés and restaurants.

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.body: The service is published by [company name], [legal form] with a capital of [amount], registered under [RNE number], with its registered office at [address], Tunisia. Publication director: [name]. Contact: [email].

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.body: Application hosted by Vercel Inc. (European Union region); data hosted by Supabase (European Union region, Paris).

ip.title: Intellectual property
ip.body: Menus, logos and photos published by venues remain theirs. The rest of the service is protected by copyright.

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.body: These terms govern the use of the digital menu and table request service by venues and their customers.

account.title: Account and subscription
account.body: The venue creates an account, chooses a plan and pays as agreed. It can cancel at any time; data is kept for 90 days, then deleted.

content.title: Content
content.body: The venue is responsible for the prices, allergens and descriptions it publishes. AI translations and imports are suggestions it approves.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: The service aims for high availability without an absolute guarantee. Incidents are reported to the venues concerned.

customers.title: Venue customers
customers.body: No account is required. An anonymous session id enables waiter calls and feedback; it expires within hours. No data is sold.

venues.title: Venues and staff
venues.body: We process the email addresses, names and roles the service needs, and security logs. Under Organic Law No. 2004-63 you may access, correct or ask us to delete your data: [email].

processors.title: Processors
processors.body: Vercel (hosting), Supabase (database), Google (AI for menu import and translation, without personal data), a transactional email service.

cafe.title: Cafés and tea rooms
cafe.body: Many tables, short orders: customers call the waiter or ask for the bill without raising a hand, and your team sees it all from the counter.

restaurant.title: Restaurants
restaurant.body: A rich menu with photos, options and allergens, readable in three languages by Tunisian customers and tourists alike.

services.title: Everything a modern service needs
services.description: One tool for your menu, your tables and your team. Here is what we do for your venue.

menu.title: Digital menu
menu.body: Your menu online with photos, prices, options and allergens. Change a price or hide a sold-out dish: it shows at once.

qr.title: QR codes on tables
qr.body: One QR code per table on a tent with your name, ready to print. Customers scan with the camera, no app.

service.title: Waiter calls and bills
service.body: From the table, customers call the waiter or ask for the bill, cash or card. Basic plan.

languages.title: French, Arabic, English
languages.body: Every customer reads the menu in their language, Arabic right to left. Automatic translation saves you hours.

ai.title: Menu import from a photo
ai.body: Take a photo of your menu: AI reads the dishes and prices, you check, it is online.

team.title: Team screen and dashboard
team.body: The counter and waiters get calls with sound and vibration. You follow everything from your phone.

offers.title: Start simple, grow when you want
offers.description: Just the QR code menu, or the menu with table service: your choice.
offers.soon: Coming soon: table ordering and order tracking (Pro).
